From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Subject: Week Zero orchestration: scheduling, hosts, and access

Hi Sana and Doug —

Thanks again for the quick intake call yesterday. Per our handoff, I want to propose a compact Week Zero plan to get NovaCorp ready for the onboarding kickoff next week. Below are the key items we need to lock today so we can publish calendar invites and prework: 

Proposed Week Zero agenda (30–45m):
- Introductions & scope (5m) — who’s owning what from NovaCorp + Redwood
- Access & networking checklist (10m) — SSO, IP allowlist, temporary secrets
- Test run of the demo workspace (10m) — confirm model routing and sample prompt set
- Logistics & success criteria (10m) — go/no-go metrics and post-week tasks

Time slot options (all PT):
- Option A: Tue 2028-09-12 09:00–09:45
- Option B: Tue 2028-09-12 13:00–13:45
- Option C: Wed 2028-09-13 11:00–11:45

Bridge & links (placeholder until invite):
- Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/placeholder-bridge
- Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cWeekZeroPlaybook (attached playbook & prework)

Attachments: WeekZero_Playbook_v1.pdf (playbook + short prework checklist)

Monica — can you own the tech run and host the demo? Rishi — please take the access checklist and confirm whether we need any additional network info from NovaCorp before the session. 

Sana/Doug — which of the three slots works for you? If none, propose two alternatives and we’ll route accordingly.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

---
Note: Attachment: WeekZero_Playbook_v1.pdf (11 pages)
From: Doug Reynolds <doug.reynolds@novacorp.com>

Subject: Re: Week Zero orchestration: scheduling, hosts, and access

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the clear options. We can do Option C (Wed 11:00 PT) but would prefer a slightly shorter agenda if possible (30m) as our lead engineers are in a customer escalation the morning of Tue/Wed.

A couple of asks from our side: 
- Can Redwood confirm if any IP allowlist changes are required for the demo? If so, we’ll need the IPs and a short window to approve.
- Jamie (cc’d) will be our technical lead and should be added to the invite. Jamie will also own validating SSO and certs on our end.

If you need a separate procurement touchpoint for the SOW/PO, flag it — procurement will require the doc signed by Thurs 9/14.

—Doug
